name: selfinsure
description: Member-owned insurance mutuals as an Ethereum contract: operator fee capped at 10% and published on chain, 7-day fee notice, pro-rata surplus rebates, FIFO unfunded queue, agent-adjudicated claims, optional oracle for real data (advisory / required / automatic), and a US health mutual template with a 0% operator fee

local.note: addresses from script/Demo.s.sol; redeploy with forge script

mcp.docs: 26 tools. Off-chain pools: si_pools, si_pool, si_create_pool, si_set_terms, si_quote, si_join, si_premium, si_donate, si_member, si_register_agent, si_admit_agent, si_agents, si_claim_file, si_queue, si_claim, si_vote, si_withdraw_claim, si_distribute, si_withdraw_fees, si_ledger, si_stats. On-chain: si_contract (describe/source/abi/compile/calls), si_preset (health/parametric/mutual terms scaled to an asset), si_deploy (through the eth module keystore), si_onchain (a live pool: money, the provider's profit share, solvency), si_onchain_claim.
